topics.title: Automation of job search and resume generation

claims.text: The author plans to set up a cloud system that fully automates searching for job vacancies, generating PDF resumes tailored to each vacancy, and writing cover letters.
Modern job seekers need to add many AI-related skills (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, LLM, RAG, embeddings) to avoid being filtered out by recruiters.
The acceleration of development tools started around 2025, making them sufficiently good but also increasingly expensive.

topics.title: Perceived shift in AI relevance for developers

claims.text: AI tools have moved from being a niche curiosity in 2024 to a mainstream market in 2026, making lack of AI knowledge a barrier for JS/Python job seekers.

topics.title: Risks of AI-generated code in production

claims.text: AI-generated code can produce overly large and inefficient queries (e.g., 450 lines of raw SQL) that severely degrade performance and raise security concerns.
